panels.title: Collect-Fundamentals: source + rules
panels.body:
**Finnhub stock/metric?metric=all**, one call per non-ETF ticker, 1.1 s apart, about a minute. About 130 fields; the mapped ones land in intel.fundamentals columns, the whole payload stays in `raw`.
**Units**: Finnhub gives market cap and volume in millions and growth, margins and ROE in percent. Stored as dollars, shares and fractions. fcf_yield = 1 / (EV / FCF).
**Coverage** varies a lot on this watchlist: mature names return everything, pre-profit names have no P/E, EV/EBITDA or FCF multiple, a few return little beyond market cap and balance sheet. Missing is stored as NULL, never zero; the value score reads what exists and records its coverage.
One snapshot per ticker per session (as_of), upserted, so the history of multiples builds up daily.

zones.title: Fan out + fetch
zones.body: One item per non-ETF ticker. neverError with the full response: a bad reply becomes a ledger row, not a crash.

zones.title: Normalize + store
zones.body: Unit conversion, then one transaction: upsert on (ticker, as_of) plus one intel.api_usage row per call.

zones.title: Return
zones.body: Counts and failed tickers go back to Daily for the run status.
